## What changed

Describe the user problem and the solution.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] E2E tests run when user journeys changed

## Quality review

- [ ] Added/updated tests for behavior changes
- [ ] Considered leap-year/date-boundary/timezone edge cases where relevant
- [ ] Checked keyboard and screen-reader behavior for UI changes
- [ ] Checked dark/light/system themes for UI changes
- [ ] No secrets, private personal data, or production credentials added
- [ ] Documentation/changelog updated when needed

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for visual changes, using fictional data.
